fields.capability: The capability a package holding this skill exercises (SKILL.md section 3). One agent may hold several.
fields.stage: Route position: a gate letter, a qualification stage, a companion, or lead.
fields.inputs: Decision artifacts that must be accepted before the skill runs.
fields.outputs: The decision record the skill returns.
fields.parallel: per-subject: independent instances may run concurrently on disjoint subjects; none: one instance per run.
fields.writes: What a package holding the skill may change. Anything but none needs an exclusive write set.
fields.exclusive: Shared files a writer must own alone; packages touching them are serialized.
fields.verify: The independent check another agent runs on this skill's output.
fields.failure: Decisions that stop dependents and route back or escalate.
